a: Sev1 usually means critical user-facing outage.
Sev2 is major degradation with significant impact.
Sev3 is limited impact or workaround exists.
Share impact, status, and next update time during outages.
Include summary, timeline, root cause, and action items.
Track postmortem actions to completion with owners.
Fair rotations and handoffs prevent burnout.
Alerts should be actionable, not merely informational.
Runbooks start with symptoms and immediate checks.
Capture learnings from game days into improved runbooks.
